judgment.rationale: Both are Primary Three Performance Objectives under the same Topic '1. Money' (Sub-Theme Primary Measures). The first covers changing money not exceeding ₦20 into smaller units; the second covers simple multiplication involving money with a product not exceeding ₦20. They share substantive money-operation coherence (naira, amounts up to ₦20) and reinforce each other as complementary money skills. However, both sit at the same Grade rank (PRIMARY THREE, rank 2) and the evidence (shared money/naira LC tokens, source proximity, numbered ordering) does not substantively establish that proficiency in changing money into units is a developmental prerequisite for multiplying money rather than a parallel skill, so a directional buildsTowards is not warranted; the coherence supports a symmetric relatesTo.

judgment.rationale: Second SFI (dc402838) is a PRIMARY ONE (rank 0) objective: 'cross-check the correctness of addition in everyday life' under Topic Addition. First SFI (89cc295a) is a PRIMARY TWO (rank 1) objective: 'apply correctness in multiplications as important in everyday activities' under Topic Multiplication. The lower-to-higher grade progression matches the permitted second_to_first direction, and proficiency in checking correctness of addition plausibly supports applying correctness in multiplication. Shared tokens (correctness, everyday, Basic Operations theme) reflect this genuine developmental coherence rather than mere wording overlap, though the operations differ, warranting moderate confidence.

judgment.rationale: First objective is 'subtract fractions with the same denominator' (Theme Basic Operations, Topic Subtraction); second is 'divide shapes into ½, 1/3, ¼ etc.' (Theme Number and Numeration, Sub-Theme Fraction), a foundational partitioning/representation activity that establishes what a fraction is. Both are Primary Three (rank 2). The conceptual understanding of fractions as parts of a whole developed by dividing shapes substantively supports the ability to operate on fractions such as subtracting like-denominator fractions, justifying a same-rank developmental direction from the second to the first. Shared 'fractions' LC token and text overlap alone are supporting context, not the basis; the pedagogical foundation-to-operation link drives the direction.
